From your screenshots, this is not a normal Express logger middleware. Affordmed wants you to build a custom logging package that calls their Log API.

For Full Stack, your repository should look like:

logging_middleware/
notification_app_be/
notification_app_fe/
notification_system_design.md
What to do first
1. Create logging_middleware

Inside it create:

logging_middleware/
├── auth.js
├── logger.js
├── constants.js
└── package.json
2. Register and get token

Call:

POST /evaluation-service/register

Get:

{
  "clientID": "...",
  "clientSecret": "..."
}

Then call:

POST /evaluation-service/auth

Store:

const ACCESS_TOKEN = "...";
3. Create reusable logger
// logging_middleware/logger.js

const axios = require("axios");

async function Log(stack, level, pkg, message) {
  try {
    await axios.post(
      "http://20.244.56.144/evaluation-service/logs",
      {
        stack,
        level,
        package: pkg,
        message
      },
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
        }
      }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
  }
}

module.exports = Log;
Where to use in Full Stack?
Backend
// server start
Log("backend", "info", "route", "Server started");
// controller
Log("backend", "info", "controller", "Fetching notifications");
catch(error){
 Log("backend","error","controller",error.message);
}

Packages allowed for backend:

cache
controller
cron_job
db
domain
handler
repository
route
service
Frontend (React)
useEffect(() => {
   Log(
      "frontend",
      "info",
      "component",
      "Notification page mounted"
   );
}, []);

Packages allowed:

api
component
hook
page
state
style
Most important observation from your screenshots

The document says:

Write a reusable function matching:

Log(stack, level, package, message)

So the evaluator will likely search for a function with this exact signature.

Use:

Log("backend","error","handler","received string, expected bool");

not:

logger.error(...)
For Full Stack submission
Repo
│
├── logging_middleware   ← build first
├── notification_app_be
├── notification_app_fe
└── notification_system_design.md

Build the Log() utility first, then import it everywhere in backend and frontend. That's the core requirement shown in your screenshots.
